Added the [privilegedReadSetting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/privilegedreadsetting?view=graph-rest-beta) resource type for resource policy management and evaluation.

Added the **resourcePolicy** relationship to the [admin](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/admin?view=graph-rest-beta) resource to access resource policy management and evaluation.
Added the **policyCategory** enumeration for the [resource policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/resourcepolicyroot?view=graph-rest-beta) APIs.
Added the **policyApplicableOperations** enumeration for the [resource policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/resourcepolicyroot?view=graph-rest-beta) APIs.
Added the **policyEffects** enumeration for the [resource policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/resourcepolicyroot?view=graph-rest-beta) APIs.
Added the **requestHttpMethod** enumeration for the [resource policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/resourcepolicyroot?view=graph-rest-beta) APIs.
Added the **enforcementMode** enumeration for the [resource policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/resourcepolicyroot?view=graph-rest-beta) APIs.
Added the [List resourcePolicyDefinition objects](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicyroot-list-definitions?view=graph-rest-beta) operation for resource policies.

Added the [Get resourcePolicyDefinition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicydefinition-get?view=graph-rest-beta) operation to retrieve an individual customer-authored, built-in, or deleted definition as JSON or plain-text Rego.
Added the [Create resourcePolicyDefinition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicydefinition-create?view=graph-rest-beta) operation with JSON and plain-text Rego request bodies.
Added the [Update resourcePolicyDefinition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicydefinition-update?view=graph-rest-beta) operation with JSON and plain-text Rego request bodies.

Added the [Upsert resourcePolicyDefinition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicydefinition-upsert?view=graph-rest-beta) operation for declarative deployments, such as Bicep templates, using JSON or plain-text Rego policies.

Added the [Delete resourcePolicyDefinition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicydefinition-delete?view=graph-rest-beta) and [Permanently delete resourcePolicyDefinition](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicydeletableroot-delete-definitions?view=graph-rest-beta) operations for resource policies.
Added the [resourcePolicyDefinition: restore](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicydefinition-restore?view=graph-rest-beta) operation for resource policies.

Added the [Get resourcePolicyConfiguration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resourcepolicyconfiguration-get?view=graph-rest-beta) operation for resource policies.
